summary_md:
# 280. Vad har USA, hälsa och konsumenter gemensamt?

**Feed**: aktiepodden  
**Published**: 2026-11-06  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

Aktiespodden episode 280 combines a USA theme from the new Aktiespararen magazine with a post-midterm market read. After the election, AI stocks fell and money rotated into defensive healthcare. The hosts discuss the Riksbank's rate hike against a strong Swedish PMI, and they cover Q3 reports. They are positive on Medicover, RaySearch (despite a margin miss), Kamurus, Apotea, KABE and Nya/NIAB. They are negative on Nobia and Boule's plan to drop instruments. They also warn against bottom-fishing turnarounds and say consumer confidence about the year ahead is weakening.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟡 RAY-B — RaySearch | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Third straight miss, but order intake is very strong and full-year guidance is kept. Host stays positive and expects margins to recover.

#### Reasoning

The Q3 margin miss came from an unusually high hardware share (~20% vs ~10%), which pushed gross margin to 84% from over 90%. Order intake +30% and record revenue point to future software income. The host keeps a positive view, though the volatility justifies a valuation discount.

#### Sell Triggers

- if Q4 misses the guidance-implied strong quarter
- if gross margin stays below 90%
- if order intake weakens

> *"Jag håller ändå fast vid en positiv syn på aktien."*

---

### 🟢 MCOV-B — Medicover | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 70%

Strong Q3, market-share gains in Germany, India sale, capex hump easing, clinic-closure drag fading from Q4. Held by the host fund.

#### Reasoning

EBIT rose sharply. Pressure on public reimbursement hurts competitors more, so Medicover gains share. Selling India strengthens the balance sheet for focus on Poland, Romania and Germany. Higher capacity use should lift margins, and the net-new-site timing drag should ease into 2027.

#### Sell Triggers

- if German reimbursement cuts widen materially
- if margin expansion fails to materialise in 2027
- if the India divestment stalls

> *"Jätteintressant aktie tycker jag."*

---

### 🟢 CAMX — Kamurus | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Revenue +28% beat forecasts, recovering from US insurance losses. Strong balance sheet; acromegaly pipeline.

#### Reasoning

Called a 'fantastic company'. The US coverage loss was a one-off and has been clawed back. Growth is back, and a strong balance sheet allows acquisitions or business development alongside the acromegaly project.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the US payer mix deteriorates again
- if acromegaly costs balloon without progress

> *"Kamurus, fantastiskt bolag, kom också med rapport här."*

---

### 🟡 APOTEA — Apotea | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Strong report and structural margin gain from the Varberg warehouse, but valuation is over 20x EBIT and the stock is near its all-time high.

#### Reasoning

Growth sped up to 12-13% in a structurally strong pharmacy e-commerce segment. Warehouse efficiencies likely lift forecasts. The host flags a stretched valuation against other e-retailers.

#### Sell Triggers

- if growth decelerates
- if the valuation premium can't be sustained

> *"Jag noterar dock att värderingen har kommit upp rejält."*

---

### ⛔ NOBI — Nobia | **AVOID** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

New cost cuts, stock down ~30%. Hosts use it as a falling-knife warning and prefer turnarounds already visible in the numbers.

#### Reasoning

The company keeps needing savings programmes. The hosts warn that mean-reversion hopes can fail and that some companies simply aren't good. They prefer to wait for a confirmed turnaround.

> *"Aktien imploderade. Den var nästan 30 % ner."*

---

### ⛔ BOUL — Boule Diagnostics | **AVOID** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Dropping instruments to focus on consumables plus a SEK 93m rights issue. Hosts doubt the model can last.

#### Reasoning

Without new installed systems, the consumables and service base will shrink over time. Lower costs and a stronger balance sheet only buy a few years.

> *"det är lite så här såga av grenen man sitter på"*

---

### 🟢 NIAB — NIAB / Nya | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 65%

Record orders, backlog +116%, 10x EBIT, exposed to electrification and data centers. Finnish margins should normalise from Q4.

#### Reasoning

Large beat and a growing pipeline, with phase-1 projects equal to about 15% of the backlog that are likely to convert. Finnish start-up costs and low-margin legacy contracts roll off from Q4. A low valuation on a structurally well-placed company.

#### Sell Triggers

- if Finnish margins fail to normalise from Q4
- if phase-1 projects don't convert to orders

> *"Det är en jätteintressant aktie som man ska hålla ögonen på."*

---

### 🟠 KABE-B — KABE | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Higher earnings and a strong stock reaction after a challenging market. Host has a soft spot for the company.

#### Reasoning

A recovering earnings trend in a tough leisure-vehicle market, and management is cost-disciplined. No explicit buy call.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the caravan market weakens again

> *"Kabe, fantastiskt bolag, steg rejält"*
